title: Robotics Engineer
jobDescription:
Work Type: On-site Location: Mumbai (Dadar) Job Type: Full-time Experience: 1–3 Years About the role We're building learning-based control for diverse robotic systems, aimed at real-world deployment in industrial setups. We pair classical robotics
- kinematics, dynamics, perception, navigation, control
- with modern vision-language-action (VLA) models, and we care as much about what happens on real hardware as in simulation. You'll join a small, technically dense team where your work ships to physical robots quickly. If you like the space between "the model said to move here" and "the arm actually moved there, safely," this is that job. What you'll do Model and characterize robot manipulators: kinematics, dynamics, coordinate frames, calibration. Build and maintain robot models and simulation environments, and keep sim behavior faithful to the real arms. Bring up hardware: servo/motor control, sensor integration, teleoperation and data-collection rigs. Work at the boundary between classical control and learned policies
- turning a policy's output into safe, reliable motion on hardware. Creation of data flywheel for model fine-tuning for multiple tasks and embodiments Set up evaluation: reproducible benchmarks in sim and on the robot, with honest metrics. Debug the messy real-world failures that never show up in a paper. What we're looking for 1–3 years of hands-on robotics experience (industry, research lab, or a serious body of personal/open-source work). Strong grounding in classical robotics : forward/inverse kinematics, rigid-body dynamics, trajectory generation, feedback control, transforms. Experience with robot modeling (e.g. URDF / MJCF / SDF) and at least one physics simulator (Mu Jo Co, Isaac Sim/Gym, Gazebo, Py Bullet, or similar). Proficient in Python and C++ . Comfortable on Linux, with Git, and working close to hardware. Clear communicator who can reason from first principles and validate claims against real data or source code rather than intuition alone. Nice to have (a plus, not required) A portfolio of robotics work
- repos, demos, videos, publications, competition entries, or a personal project we can look at. Exposure to learning-based robotics: imitation learning, VLA models, or RL for control. Hands-on time with real manipulators and grippers. Perception experience (depth cameras, point clouds, hand-eye calibration). Background in optimization or optimal control. Familiarity with the Le Robot / Open VLA ecosystem. Why join Real robots, real deployment targets, short loop from idea to hardware. A team strong in controls, safety, and systems
- you'll learn fast.

title: Sourcing & Compliance Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Title: Sourcing & Compliance Engineer Department: Supply Chain Management Reports To: AVP – SCM / Head
- SCM Location: Mumbai, India (Domestic & International Travel as Required) Role Overview We are seeking a Sourcing & Compliance Engineer with expertise in electronics sourcing, supplier audits, and regulatory compliance. This role ensures that all materials, components, and finished products meet global safety, EMI/EMC, and certification standards while supporting supplier qualification, quality improvement, and production line setups for high-volume consumer electronics. The candidate will work closely with engineering, operations, and quality teams to ensure that compliance, reliability, and manufacturability are embedded throughout the product lifecycle. Key Responsibilities
1. Compliance & Certification (Primary Focus) Identify applicable global regulations, standards, and directives for new and existing products (Ro HS, REACH, WEEE, CE, FCC, BIS, EMI/EMC, etc.). Ensure product and component compliance for safety, environmental, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC/EMI) requirements. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, certification files, Do Cs, and test reports across all geographies. Liaise with third-party labs, consultants, and certification agencies for product testing, validation, and regulatory approvals. Monitor regulatory updates and assess their impact on existing SKUs, suppliers, and new developments. Embed compliance and safety requirements early in the product design and sourcing cycle (DFMA/pre-compliance stage). Manage product lifecycle compliance including PCN/EOL documentation, material declarations, and change control.
2. Supplier Quality & Audits Conduct supplier and factory audits to evaluate quality systems, process capability, and compliance readiness (ISO 9001, ISO 14001). Verify material and component quality through inspection, documentation checks, and qualification processes (PPAP/FAI). Lead CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions) for supplier non-conformities or audit findings. Support production line setup, validation, and process improvement during new product introductions (NPI) and mass production. Collaborate with quality teams to define inspection standards, incoming QC SOPs, and reliability test procedures.
3. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner with Engineering, Product, and Operations to ensure sourcing and compliance align with technical and business goals. Provide compliance and safety inputs to design teams for new component development and alternate sourcing. Support procurement and logistics teams with compliance documentation (e.g., COC, Ro HS/REACH declarations, test certificates). Act as a key interface between internal stakeholders and external partners for all compliance-related matters. Qualifications B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering (Master’s or MBA preferred). 3–6 years of experience in electronics sourcing, supplier quality, or product compliance in a consumer electronics or EMS/ODM environment. Strong working knowledge of product safety and certification frameworks (CE, FCC, BIS, etc.). Hands-on experience with PCBA fabrication, EMS/ODM vendor management, and electronics component sourcing. Excellent analytical, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills. Key Competencies Deep understanding of compliance, EMI/EMC, and certification frameworks. Proven ability to identify compliance gaps and implement systemic corrective actions. Strong audit, documentation, and supplier management skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously. Collaborative and outcome-driven, with a focus on quality, cost, and regulatory integrity.

title: Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer in the team. In this role, candidate is expected to have a hands-on experience in hardware design and development of digital and analogue electronics; analogue and mixed domain circuits solutions. As a core member of Electronics system design team you will drive microprocessors/ micro controllers, So C / So M based processing unit design and peripheral interface control, power electronics for power supply, power distribution and battery charging management, BMS and embedded systems board bring-up, integration, functional and environmental qualification. Core

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Design and develop electronics hardware platform for multiple projects.
2. Partner with the embedded software team for hardware/ firmware co-design, development and integration; optimization.
3. Ability to make sense of complex functional requirements, synthesize and build-up appropriate electronics hardware based solutions.
4. Create a reliable, modular design and qualify the integrated design with respect to the functional and environmental performance requirements. Requirements & Skills: Must to have:
1. 6 year to 10 years of experience in low-power circuit design, manufactured PCB bring-up, engineering-build integration and debug the performance issues in the integrated product.
2. 4 year to 8 years of experience driving design development from component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, assembly and integration with other modules of product.
3. 5+ of experience in development of Multi-layer, mixed-signal board-level design in Altium/ Eagle.
4. Experience of power supply topologies: DC-DC, Flyback Converters, LDOs, etc.
5. Experience of Battery charger design, signal conditioning, sensor interface; protection circuits.
6. Hand-on experience in hardware implementation of embedded system data communication protocols such as 1-wire, I2C, SPI, UART, USB, TCP/ IP, wireless, BLE, MIPI
7. Experience of BDC/ BLDC or steppers motors, motor driver circuit design and its working and protection principles.
8. Diverse experience in microcontroller/ microprocessor based circuit design and bring-up. Ideally from ST/ TI/ NXP/ Renesas and sensor interface on PCBA level.
9. Ability to Interface sensors (sensor signal conditioning and instrumentation) like current-voltage, Time-of- Flight, Proximity, Position, ALS, etc on a PCBA level.
10. Knowledge about Design calculations/ Worst-case performance analysis, Design Documentation during Product Development Life-Cycle milestones. 11.Knowledge of EMI/ EMC/ ESD performance standards and practices is preferred. Good to have:
1. Strong communication and documentation skills and ability to operate independently.
2. Experience with portable, battery operated designs and power budgeting.
3. Knowledge about Wi-fi/ Bluetooth/ RF/ Antenna Technologies .
4. Experience of Microphone and Speaker interface circuit design is a plus
5. Familiar with PCB fabrication technologies, Rigid-Flex PCBs, Flex Cables.
6. Hands-on experience of manufacturing process including DFM and DFT for consumer products at scale.
7. Familiar with MIPI Camera CSI and DSI ; display Modules and their communication protocols applications; Audio signal Processing and interface.

title: Gujarati Content Reviewer
jobDescription: We are looking for a Gujarati content reviewer to check educational assessment questions for school students (Grades 1–10). The review work is in Gujarati and you will be the quality check that ensures every Gujarati question is accurate, age-appropriate, and aligned with the GSEB curriculum before it is used. Fluency in English is also required, as source material and working communication are in English. What you'll do: Review Gujarati assessment questions for factual accuracy and curriculum alignment. Check that each question is age-appropriate for its grade right level of difficulty, vocabulary, and concept for the child. Confirm language quality: correct, natural, developmentally appropriate Gujarati phrasing, especially for younger learners. Verify each question has one clear correct answer and sensible options, and is clearly worded and self-contained. Flag anything off-syllabus, inaccurate, ambiguous, or developmentally unsuitable, with a short reason. Requirements: GSEB Teaching experience at primary or secondary level, as a subject-matter expert in at least one subject. Strong familiarity with the GSEB curriculum — what each grade covers and how concepts are sequenced. Fluent in both Gujarati and English — native or near-native Gujarati for reviewing and correcting content, along with strong English skills to work effectively in an English-medium instructional environment. A teaching or child-development background, or equivalent experience judging what is right for children of a given age. Careful, detail-oriented, and comfortable explaining clearly why something is correct or wrong. Basic technical comfort — able to work confidently in spreadsheets and pick up a simple software/review utility with light training. Nice to have: Experience reviewing or writing educational content or assessments.
